name: Emoji
description: Emojis are small digital images or icons used to express ideas, emotions, objects, or concepts in electronic communication. The word ``emoji`` comes from Japanese, combining ``e``, picture and ``moji``, character or letter.
code:
<?php

    // Emoji, directly in the string, when the file is also supporting Unicode, like with UTF8
    echo "Hello 😊";
    
    // Emoji, with a PHP escape sequence
    echo "\u{1F60A}";
    
    // Emoji, with an HTML escape sequence
    echo "😊";

?>

citations.name: Where you can (and can't) use Emoji in PHP
